scope: Source and imported-asset optimization. No new Windows/WebGL player, deployment or whole-game FPS certification in this change.

changes: Cache hand, finger and torso bone references; sample equipment frames once per visible pose.
Skip inactive equipment fitting and presentation-only pose copies on non-rendered 120 Hz simulation updates.
Keep local player and selector preview at original mesh detail.
Generate two lower-detail mesh index levels while preserving original vertex streams, skin weights, bind poses and LOD0.
Preserve original facial/eye and small material index ranges at every LOD after visual QA exposed missing eyes in unrestricted simplification.
Remove direct imported-prefab dependencies from selection metadata.
Load requested visual prefabs with shared asynchronous ResourceRequests in gameplay and selector UI.
Cancel obsolete selection callbacks and resume deferred visual selection on reactivation.
limits: Resources assets still ship in initial Web data; this is on-demand instantiation/loading, not a reduced network payload.
Loaded character resources remain cached. Server-side validation and compatibility accessors may still load synchronously.

changes: Scene-owned bounded reuse pool for arrow trails and hook/knife presentation objects.
Reset reused flight state and prevent stale owners from controlling a recycled object.
Compute two oriented hook rings once, reuse topology/normals and conservative bounds; skip identical endpoints.
limits: Network-authoritative arrow objects retain existing Mirror spawn/despawn semantics.
Other low-frequency effects were not indiscriminately converted to pooling.

changes: Avoid duplicate ScheduleFlushSend jobs when no driver update or send has occurred since the last flush.
Preserve polling, reliable packet handling, ACK/keepalive updates and combat timing.
Record supported CPU/GPU, GC, memory, draw-call, SetPass, triangle and custom pose/hook counters.
Count displayed frames separately from native 120 Hz simulation updates.
Include render scale, adaptive tier and render interval in comparison conditions; optionally freeze automatic quality.
Add Unity development Web profiler control to the custom shell.

measurements.method: Paired Editor EditMode microbenchmarks in the same process, alternating legacy/new order over three rounds. Legacy classes copied from baseline revision then removed. Static evaluated player pose: 100 warmup and 500 calls/round. Hook: 100 warmup and 1000 calls/round, alternating endpoint x=0/0.01 for moving cases. Median per-call durations. No rendering, network traffic or Web player timings.
limitations: Editor scheduling and CPU load cause noise; raw results retained, including a legacy pose outlier.
Function cost reductions do not equal whole-game FPS gains.
Mesh LOD reduces triangles but does not reduce skinning bone/vertex cost; Unity skins LOD0 vertices.

reproduction.poseBody: var catalog = UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<BattlePvp.Characters.CharacterCatalog>("Assets/Resources/CharacterCatalog.asset"); var prefab = UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab"); var rows = new System.Collections.Generic.List<object>(); foreach (var id in new [] {"megumi", "casual-1", "picochan"}) { var oldPlayer = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(prefab); var player = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(prefab); try { var animator = oldPlayer.GetComponent<Animator>(); animator.Rebind(); animator.Update(0); var original = oldPlayer.GetComponentInChildren<SkinnedMeshRenderer>(true); var originalMesh=original.sharedMesh; var visual=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(catalog.Find(id).VisualPrefab, oldPlayer.transform, false); var legacy=visual.AddComponent<BattlePvp.Characters.LegacyPoseBenchmark>(); original.sharedMesh=null; legacy.Initialize(animator, original, originalMesh); animator=player.GetComponent<Animator>(); animator.Rebind(); animator.Update(0); using (var skin = new BattlePvp.Characters.CharacterSkin(player.GetComponentInChildren<SkinnedMeshRenderer>(true))) { string error; if (!skin.Apply(catalog.Find(id), out error)) throw new System.Exception(error); var follower = player.GetComponentInChildren<BattlePvp.Characters.CharacterPoseFollower>(); for(int i=0;i<100;i++) {legacy.SyncPose();follower.SyncPose();} for(int round=0;round<3;round++) { for(int step=0;step<2;step++) { bool optimized=((round+step)%2)==1; System.Action action=optimized ? (System.Action)follower.SyncPose : legacy.SyncPose; var watch = new System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch(); long before = System.GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread(); watch.Start(); for(int i=0;i<500;i++) action(); watch.Stop(); rows.Add(new {id=id,round=round,optimized=optimized,iterations=500,totalMs=watch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds,allocatedBytes=System.GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread()-before}); } } } } finally {UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(oldPlayer);UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(player);} } return rows;

(System.Action<Vector3,Vector3>)chain.Update : oldChain.Update; for(int i=0;i<100;i++) action(Vector3.zero,new Vector3((i%2)*.01f,0,length)); var watch=new System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch(); long before=System.GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread(); watch.Start(); for(int i=0;i<1000;i++) action(Vector3.zero,new Vector3(moving ? (i%2)*.01f : 0,0,length)); watch.Stop(); rows.Add(new {length=length,round=round,moving=moving,optimized=optimized,iterations=1000,totalMs=watch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds,allocatedBytes=System.GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread()-before});}} return rows;
